recentItems.title: FEAR FACTORY - Roboticist (OFFICIAL MUSIC VIDEO)
recentItems.description:
Industrial metal pioneers @fearfactorymusic launches a bold new era with "Roboticist," — the latest single marks the recording debut of the band's current lineup featuring vocalist Milo Silvestro, drummer Pete Webber, and bassist Tony Campos. Blending crushing mechanical aggression with a haunting, melodic hook, the track explores a dystopian reality where flesh fails and only consciousness endures.

"The future isn’t coming. It’s already here, ‘Roboticist’ is the next evolution of Fear Factory.
Man, Machine and the war for what comes next. I can’t wait for everyone to hear the beginning of a new era of Fear Factory."
Dino Cazares

Produced, engineered, mixed, and mastered by Damien Rainaud, the single arrives alongside a cinematic music video directed by Vincente Cordero and produced by Arion Csihar. System activated: the next chapter of FEAR FACTORY has officially begun.

---

DOWN was never just a band. It’s a brotherhood rooted in childhood friendships that have endured for decades. It’s an homage to the city of New Orleans, Louisiana. It’s music meant for anybody who has ever headbanged, played air guitar, or worn a weathered tour t-shirt like armor. For over three decades, the quintet  – Philip H. Anselmo, Pepper Keenan, Kirk Windstein, Jimmy Bower, and Pat Bruders – have quietly built a legacy like no other. When these individuals congregate, magic ensues, conjured by earthquaking grooves, bellowing straight from the soul, and riffing loud enough to awaken an ancient deity.

This Fall, DOWN begins another chapter with Volume V.

DOWN:
Philip H. Anselmo – vocals
Pepper Keenan – guitars
Jimmy Bower – drums
Kirk Windstein – guitars
Pat Bruders – bass

recentItems.description:
The new single Black Magick Radio is out now: https://greenlung.bfan.link/black-magick-radio.yde | Pre-order the album here: https://greenlung.bfan.link/necropolitan.yde

Director + Editor: Billy Howard Price @billyhprice
DOP: Jack Worrall @j.w.worrall.dop
Produced by Adam John Watts @adamjohnwattss
Co-Produced by Rory Bannister @rorybannister
1st AC: Ed Day @edwardalexday
Gaffer: Jay at London Lighting @jtesfam_ @londonlighting10
Art Dept. Tom Healy @ttomhealey
Costume: Adam Aouati @adzoh
MUA: Charis Smith-Halvorsen @makeup.bycharis
Colour: Mara Ciorba at Harbor @maraciorba @harborpictureco
Globe Animation: Joseph Brett @josephbrett 

In the outlaw spirit of 1960s pirate radio, Green Lung have hijacked the airwaves to broadcast their own distinctive form of sonic propaganda. Turning the dial left and tuning into vintage influences from Lucifer’s Friend to Black Widow, new single 'Black Magick Radio' traces the history of occult rock itself, as well as namechecking London proto-goth landmarks such as Le Macabre (a Soho cafe where you could ‘drink your coffee off a coffin’) and The Process Church of the Final Judgement (a pre-Manson cult based in Mayfair). A celebration of magickal rock through the ages and around the world, this new transmission will charm initiates and ipsissimi alike.
